evidence_kind: Declared software synchronization and host-edit contract; no hardware law or measurement
scope: Undoable APVTS snapshots and the live MODERN_LAYER child, including host-worker calls
source_basis: src/plugin/UndoHistory.h: user gestures enter undo history; host automation, MIDI learn, loads and restores do not
JUCE 8.0.11 AudioProcessorValueTreeState::copyState: flushParameterValuesToValueTree uses the APVTS UndoManager before returning a detached copy
src/plugin/ModernLayerState.h: modern configuration is a child of APVTS state and edits/restores may arrive on any non-audio thread
User completion requirement: APVTS state copy/replacement takes getUndoableState().treeLock() and calls syncNow() first

fixtures.name: worker_automation_immediately_followed_by_host_snapshot
fixtures.sequence: Create one user edit. Without pumping the message loop, a joined worker changes a different host parameter and immediately calls getStateInformation. Check the saved normalized/physical value against the directly observed legal host parameter value; undo/redo must replay only the original user edit, leaving the worker-automated value unchanged.
fixtures.thread_control: Thread join and explicit synchronization events; no sleep or timer flush may separate the worker automation from its snapshot.

fixtures.name: worker_sync_now_updates_external_state_without_undo
fixtures.sequence: A worker changes a parameter, then holds the common tree lock and calls syncNow. The live parameter child must contain its current host value and history must contain no new action. No message-thread timer is allowed to supply the result.

fixtures.name: snapshot_during_pending_user_gesture
fixtures.sequence: Begin and change a user gesture on the message thread, then capture state on a joined worker before the gesture ends or a timer runs. The detached snapshot must contain the current value; the worker must not add a generic property undo action. Ending the gesture must preserve one coalesced user transaction with balanced begin/end notifications on subsequent undo and redo.

fixtures.name: modern_live_tree_write_owns_common_lock
fixtures.sequence: Observe actual MODERN_LAYER ValueTree mutation callbacks. At those synchronous callbacks a distinct probe thread attempts only tryEnter on the APVTS common tree lock. Every attempt must fail while the production writer is inside the mutation; the probe never waits on that lock. Cover both initial child insertion and replacement of an existing child.

fixtures.name: modern_live_tree_read_owns_common_lock
fixtures.sequence: Exercise the production tree-read operation with a test-only reader witness at the point where it consumes the live MODERN_LAYER child. A distinct probe thread's tryEnter must fail. The witness must use the same production lock scope, without a separately implemented reference lock or a runtime production mode switch.

fixtures.name: modern_configuration_snapshot_restore_and_undo
fixtures.sequence: Use non-default MSEG points, loop/trigger/sync/bipolar fields, and matrix routing. Snapshot and restore through the processor host APIs, preserving exact sanitized configuration and unrelated host parameters. Observe common-lock ownership during modern-subtree undo/redo callbacks as well as normal edits.

lock_order.required: APVTS common tree lock before ModernLayerState configuration lock; never acquire the common tree lock while holding the configuration lock. Hold the common lock across a coherent live-tree/configuration transaction.
lock_order.audio_thread: The audio thread continues to consume the existing mailbox with try-lock only; it never takes the APVTS common lock and never waits for a message-thread operation.
lock_order.worker_snapshot: Must finish without message-thread dispatch while the message thread joins it; no MessageManagerLock or synchronous UI callback is permitted.
lock_order.undo_manager: Worker snapshots and external synchronization must not write user undo actions. Parameter replay remains protected against recursive recording.

required_mutation_checks: Restore the former worker-sync omission: the direct live-tree synchronization fixture must fail.
Restore generic live-tree recording during a worker snapshot: the history-isolation and/or unrelated-value assertion must fail.
Drop current pending-user values from a detached worker snapshot: the snapshot-value assertion must fail.
Remove the production common lock from modern live-tree writes: the synchronous write witness must fail.
Remove the production common lock from modern live-tree reads: the production reader witness must fail.
Remove common-lock protection around modern-subtree undo/redo: the replay witness must fail.
Remove replay begin/end notifications: the existing and new exact gesture checks must fail.
preservation: Keep all existing user-gesture coalescing, undo/redo, modern-state serialization, Pure/default-neutrality, UI and native host tests unchanged unless adding independent assertions.
Keep all existing tolerances and byte-identity requirements unchanged.
No audio-model, core-source, parameter-order, parameter-count, version-hint or default changes.
A timeout, deadlock, compiler failure or crash cannot count as a detected mutation or passing synchronization test.
